carta.que: Los bitcoins están en una cartera que necesita 2 de sus 3 llaves para moverlos (es lo que se llama «multisig»). No hace falta reunirlas todas: con lo que se lista abajo basta.

En un ordenador, instala una cartera que admita multisig (por ejemplo Sparrow o Nunchuk) e importa el descriptor: escaneando su QR o copiándolo.
Comprueba que la primera dirección de recepción que muestra coincide con la del descriptor impreso, si la tienes. Si coincide, la cartera es la buena.
Las frases semilla no se escriben en el ordenador: se cargan en un dispositivo de firma (una «hardware wallet») y se firma con él.

carta.que: The bitcoin is in a wallet that needs 2 of its 3 keys to move it (this is called “multisig”). You do not need to gather them all: what is listed below is enough.

If you know nothing about Bitcoin, you have time: you can learn what you need at your own pace, or ask someone you trust who knows about it to go through it with you. They should help by your side, without taking anything or asking you for the words.
On a computer, install a wallet that supports multisig (for example Sparrow or Nunchuk) and import the descriptor: by scanning its QR code or copying it.
Check that the first receive address it shows matches the one on the printed descriptor, if you have it. If it matches, it is the right wallet.
Seed phrases are not typed into the computer: they are loaded onto a signing device (a “hardware wallet”) and you sign with it.
Before moving everything, send a small amount and check that it arrives.

carta.cuando: Esta carta es para leerla tras el fallecimiento de Yo. Explica cómo recuperar sus bitcoins.
carta.que: Los bitcoins están en una cartera que necesita 2 de sus 3 llaves para moverlos (es lo que se llama «multisig»). No hace falta reunirlas todas: con lo que se lista abajo basta.
piezas: el descriptor de la cartera (la lista pública de sus llaves, sin la que no se puede reconstruir)

pasos: Cuando decidas recuperarlos, reúne las piezas de la lista y guárdalas juntas en un sitio seguro mientras dure el proceso.

Si no sabes de Bitcoin, tienes tiempo: puedes aprender lo necesario a tu ritmo, o pedir a alguien de confianza que sepa que te acompañe. Que te ayude a tu lado, sin llevarse nada ni pedirte las palabras.
En un ordenador, instala una cartera que admita multisig (por ejemplo Sparrow o Nunchuk) e importa el descriptor: escaneando su QR o copiándolo.
Comprueba que la primera dirección de recepción que muestra coincide con la del descriptor impreso, si la tienes. Si coincide, la cartera es la buena.
Las frases semilla no se escriben en el ordenador: se cargan en un dispositivo de firma (una «hardware wallet») y se firma con él.
Antes de mover todo, envía una cantidad pequeña y comprueba que llega.

If you know nothing about Bitcoin, you have time: you can learn what you need at your own pace, or ask someone you trust who knows about it to go through it with you. They should help by your side, without taking anything or asking you for the words.
On a computer, install a wallet that supports Miniscript (for example Liana) and import the descriptor: by scanning its QR code or copying it.
Check that the first receive address it shows matches the one on the printed descriptor, if you have it. If it matches, it is the right wallet.
Seed phrases are not typed into the computer: they are loaded onto a signing device (a “hardware wallet”) and you sign with it.

With what is on the list you have to wait: those keys only work once the bitcoin has gone 1 year without moving (this is what is called a “timelock”). It counts from the last time it was moved; until then, the wallet will not let you send it. Waiting carries no risk. If you do not want to wait, see “Without waiting”, above.
Before moving everything, send a small amount and check that it arrives.

carta.que: Los bitcoins están en una cartera que necesita una combinación de varias llaves para moverlos. Con lo que se lista abajo basta.

pasos: Cuando decidas recuperarlos, reúne las piezas de la lista y guárdalas juntas en un sitio seguro mientras dure el proceso.

Si no sabes de Bitcoin, tienes tiempo: puedes aprender lo necesario a tu ritmo, o pedir a alguien de confianza que sepa que te acompañe. Que te ayude a tu lado, sin llevarse nada ni pedirte las palabras.
En un ordenador, instala una cartera que admita Miniscript (por ejemplo Liana) e importa el descriptor: escaneando su QR o copiándolo.
Comprueba que la primera dirección de recepción que muestra coincide con la del descriptor impreso, si la tienes. Si coincide, la cartera es la buena.
Las frases semilla no se escriben en el ordenador: se cargan en un dispositivo de firma (una «hardware wallet») y se firma con él.
Antes de mover todo, envía una cantidad pequeña y comprueba que llega.

carta.cuando: This letter is to be read after the death of Yo. It explains how to recover their bitcoin.
carta.que: The bitcoin is in a wallet that needs 2 of its 3 keys to move it (this is called “multisig”). You do not need to gather them all: what is listed below is enough.
piezas: the seed phrase of K2
the wallet descriptor (the public list of its keys, without which it cannot be rebuilt)
the seed phrase of K1

the seed phrase of K3

pasos: When you decide to recover it, gather the pieces on the list and keep them together in a safe place for as long as the process lasts.

If you know nothing about Bitcoin, you have time: you can learn what you need at your own pace, or ask someone you trust who knows about it to go through it with you. They should help by your side, without taking anything or asking you for the words.
On a computer, install a wallet that supports multisig (for example Sparrow or Nunchuk) and import the descriptor: by scanning its QR code or copying it.
Check that the first receive address it shows matches the one on the printed descriptor, if you have it. If it matches, it is the right wallet.
Seed phrases are not typed into the computer: they are loaded onto a signing device (a “hardware wallet”) and you sign with it.
Before moving everything, send a small amount and check that it arrives.
